summary.name: Free Tegami Tools JP
summary.one_liner: A free, no-registration collection of AI tools for writing Japanese ceremonial and everyday letters and greetings, such as wedding speeches, eulogies, and new-year cards.
use_cases: Drafting a wedding or celebration speech
Writing a eulogy or funeral address
Checking a letter for taboo words (imi kotoba)
Writing a retirement or business greeting
summary.what_it_does: The site offers 82 tools, grouped by occasion: celebrations (weddings, births, Shichi-Go-San, school entrance and graduation, longevity), condolences and memorial services (eulogies, chief mourner's address, memorial invitations, condolence money notes), and seasonal or work letters (new-year cards, thank-you letters, retirement greetings, business condolence and celebration messages). A featured set includes a taboo-word checker that detects words to avoid in a text and suggests replacements, plus generators for memorial service invitations, condolence money cover letters, thank-you letters, Okuizome greetings, and Shichi-Go-San invitations. The page is in Japanese, and it is operated by 合同会社Initiate Global Strategies (IGS). The listing describes it as 65 AI tools, which differs from the 82 stated on the page itself.
notable: 82 occasion-specific Japanese letter and speech tools, no registration required
Taboo-word (忌み言葉) checker that flags words and suggests alternatives
Covers sensitive formats like mourning postcards (喪中はがき) and memorial invitations
Operated by 合同会社Initiate Global Strategies (IGS)
caveats: The page names 82 tools while the awesome-ai-tools listing says 65; the count is inconsistent across sources
Page content is in Japanese only
Output quality and suitability for formal situations are not described on the page
